proposals.explanation: The codec writes EncryptedMessageContents and EncryptionData, parses them back, rejects missing or unrecognized properties, and offers a TryDeserialize wrapper that returns false on an exception.

proposals.handwrittenRationale: The partial model supplies these explicit accessors outside Generated.

finding.handwrittenRationale: The explicit JSON writer, reader, validation, and try-wrapper are implemented under src/Models/Internal, outside Generated.

decisions.reason: The handwritten enumerator forwards the continuation and page-size hint to GetQueuesInternal and uses NextMarker to construct the returned Page (GetQueuesAsyncCollection.cs:25-43).
PeekedMessage.cs:23-33 explicitly converts its hidden string MessageText accessor to and from the public BinaryData Body in a non-generated partial model.
PeekedMessage.cs:38-45 contains CodeGenMember mappings from InsertionTime and ExpirationTime to the declared nullable timestamp properties.
PeekedMessage.cs:58-67 creates a new peeked model, copies metadata, and calls QueueMessageCodec.DecodeMessageBody with the selected encoding; the codec implementation itself is not supplied.

The distinctive behavior is nested default initialization, not merely an alternate constructor; the internal field-assignment constructor is ordinary construction. Use a reusable initialization pattern.

decisions.reason: The supplied file defines an audience value type and helpers, not a client option or constructor argument selecting the audience; the proposed catalog pattern describes a different API shape. The fixed account URL is service-specific, so general generator addressability is unproven.

finding.explanation: QueueAudience validates custom audience values, exposes the default audience, constructs an account-specific queue audience, and derives a default token scope.
finding.handwrittenRationale: The value type and endpoint/scope methods are declared and implemented in src/Models/QueueAudience.cs outside Generated.

decisions.reason: QueueCorsRule.cs:16-29 provides a public parameterless constructor and an internal constructor setting five CORS members in a non-generated partial model.
QueueErrorCode.cs:13-31 implements both string operand orders for equality/inequality and null-safe Equals(string) outside Generated; the pattern names the reusable overload shape.

QueueGeoReplication.cs:17-29 explicitly maps LastSyncTime to LastSyncedOn and declares Status as QueueGeoReplicationStatus, with internal setters. The supplied autorest.md also configures that status enum, but does not negate these handwritten declarations.
QueueGetUserDelegationKeyOptions.cs:11-40 defines the non-generated operation options type with a required expiry constructor, optional start and delegated tenant; this is an added model API shape.

Internal construction and property setters are explicit, but no generated counterpart is supplied to establish that an existing generated surface was hidden. The proposed hide-generated-surface pattern asserts more than the evidence shows.

finding.explanation: QueueItem declares public Name and Metadata getters with internal setters and an internal constructor.
finding.handwrittenRationale: The partial model explicitly declares its members under src/Models outside Generated.

decisions.reason: QueueMessage.cs:34-53 contains the hidden string-to-BinaryData accessor, null assignment handling, and an ArgumentNullException workaround in a handwritten partial model.
QueueMessage.cs:83-92 returns a new model via the factory, retaining the body and original metadata while taking PopReceipt and NextVisibleOn from UpdateReceipt.
QueueMessage.cs:94-110 null-checks the received message, decodes MessageText with the supplied encoding, and maps its receipt, count and timestamps into the public result model.
The relevant reusable behavior is conditional initialization of a nested retention policy, rather than generic alternate constructors.

finding.explanation: QueueMetrics' public default constructor initializes RetentionPolicy, whereas its internal skipInitialization path does not.
finding.handwrittenRationale: The conditional constructor body is in src/Models/QueueMetrics.cs outside Generated.

decisions.reason: QueueProperties.cs:22-32 implements an editor-hidden int accessor which casts the long count on read and forwards writes to it.
QueueProperties.cs:37-40 initializes Metadata with an OrdinalIgnoreCase dictionary, a concrete handwritten constructor behavior.
QueueRetentionPolicy.cs:16-21 explicitly adds a public parameterless and an internal Enabled-initializing constructor outside Generated.
QueueServiceProperties.cs:16-19 maps Cors with CodeGenMember and explicitly exposes a settable IList<QueueCorsRule>, suppressing the collection-property analyzer warning.
The explicit behavior is initialization of three nested property models, not merely the existence of alternative constructors.

finding.explanation: The public QueueServiceProperties constructor initializes Logging, HourMetrics and MinuteMetrics unless its internal skipInitialization path is selected.
finding.handwrittenRationale: The constructor body appears in a handwritten partial model outside Generated.

decisions.reason: The member has no alias or CodeGenMember mapping; model-property-alias describes a different change. The source shows only the declared internal setter.

decisions.reason: The distinctive constructor behavior is conditional AccessPolicy initialization; assigning Id and AccessPolicy in another internal constructor is ordinary model population.

The internal constructor and internal-set receipt properties are explicit, but the evidence does not show any previously public generated member being hidden. Several CodeGenMember attributes map identical names, while timestamp members also have explicit type/accessibility declarations.

finding.handwrittenRationale: These members and attributes are declared in the partial SendReceipt model outside Generated.

omissions.handwrittenRationale: The operator and comparison implementations are in the non-generated QueueAudience partial struct.

omissions.handwrittenRationale: Both overload implementations are in the non-generated partial factory.

omissions.explanation: QueuesModelFactory offers a UserDelegationKey creator with delegated-user tenant id and a hidden legacy overload omitting that value.

omissions.explanation: The partial model factory supplies manual public creators for QueueItem, QueueServiceStatistics, UpdateReceipt, SendReceipt, and QueueGeoReplication, populating internally settable result members for mocking.

limitations: The partial review supplies 25 files, largely alphabetically early model files. QueueClient, QueueServiceClient, URI/SAS helpers and client-side encryptors/decryptors are explicitly omitted by the review budget; this is not an exhaustive assessment of the package.

MessageIdRestClient, MessagesRestClient and KeyInfo are empty partial scaffolding and are not counted. EncryptedMessage's storage fields are covered with its codec rather than counted again as cryptographic behavior.

QueueGeoReplicationStatus is a static enum with no demonstrated generator replacement; its mere existence is not separately counted. The .NET non-Generated src attribution rule is proposed in the supplied guideline, not independently verified repository history.
QueueMessageCodec and EncryptionDataSerializer implementations are absent. Findings describe visible conversion calls, not their unseen encoding or cryptographic internals.

Only 25 of 133 eligible source files were captured; notably QueueClient, QueueServiceClient, QueueMessageCodec, encryption helpers, SAS code and REST clients were skipped. No absence or full-library coverage claim follows from these findings.

The supplied autorest.md references Swagger/AutoRest configuration, while the general guideline describes TypeSpec-generated libraries; the exact generated counterpart of these partial models is not supplied, so assertions about what was suppressed, replaced or generator-addressable remain bounded to the visible source.

Some CodeGenMember mappings and internal setters are visible without the generated partial declarations or corresponding API listing; their declared handwritten API shape is supported, but the prior generator output and its motivation cannot be verified.
